photo_standard.principle: Make each scene convincingly photographed in a physical world BEFORE adding fantasy action and editorial typography. Material realism does not require every image to look identical.
photo_standard.camera: Choose purposeful real focal length and lens height appropriate to scene, physical depth of field and coherent focus plane; avoid infinite-sharp plastic CGI.
photo_standard.geometry: Environment materials show wear, uneven aggregate, plausible cracks, reeds/roots, chipped painted wood, weathered metal and real contact shadows. World location remains unique per folio.
photo_standard.moisture: Raindrop size, wet sheen and surface runoff vary by material, puddles obey gravity, waterline is physical; rain MUST NOT uniformly coat every surface.
photo_standard.lighting: Source-driven sky/lantern/window illumination, reflections consistent with each source and object, realistic penumbra, no arbitrary glowing rim around every edge.
photo_standard.color: Muted nuanced shadows with warm practical accent, avoid over-saturated orange/teal CGI bloom and gold metal on every surface.
photo_standard.motion: Weight and inertia in movement, cloth and animal limbs follow physical forces; actionable cause/effect from source storyboard.
photo_standard.faces: Realistic anatomy and naturally textured skin/fur/fabric; exact registered characters, commissioner overrides and posed relationships, no generic character substitution.
photo_standard.composite: Cinematic visual plate and text are independent layers. Generate/choose a realistic plate, verify it, then place exact source narrative in deliberate negative-space typography at 4K, export 1080 and 390 proofs.
negative_controls: uniform foliage, repeated pebbles or cloned raindrops
impossible optics, water physics and material continuity
typographic spelling drift and invented narrative prose
generic poster portrait replacing documented action
film-like frame without readable published manuscript

print_and_resolution.target: Final composite at 4K with vector/deterministic type; if base artwork remains 941x1672 or 1080x1920, enlargement increases pixel count but does not invent high-frequency detail. Sharpness must be judged at native effective detail and phone legibility.
print_and_resolution.preserve_p09: Founder approved original P09 composition and subtle under-masthead title; do not overwrite approved source
